{{Quote|Years back, the Morgukai took me prisoner in order to lure a worthy opponent--a Jedi. They killed her, then let me go. Now they're training other Nikto on Nar Shaddaa to hunt and kill Republic targets. Someone has to stop them at their temple and drive them offworld.|[[Tythan Phomm]]|<ref name="TOR:TM" />}}
The '''Morgukai temple''' was located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and used by the Nikto [[Morgukai]] cult. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it was attacked by ba Republic team send by [[Tythan Phomm]].<ref name="TOR:TM" />
{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Morgukai temple appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:TM" />
